notes: Read SKILL.md and references/examples.md in full. Java reference for the Azure AI VoiceLive SDK (com.azure:azure-ai-voicelive): client creation, WebSocket session start/configuration, server VAD, PCM16 microphone/speaker streaming, event handling, voices, function calling and a complete voice-assistant example.

No commands, installs, or agent-side network access: dependencies are pinned Maven XML snippets (azure-ai-voicelive 1.0.0-beta.2, azure-identity 1.14.2, reactor-core 3.6.0) for the user's pom.xml, the bash fences only list placeholder environment variables, and all service calls are Java sample code reading AZURE_VOICELIVE_ENDPOINT/AZURE_VOICELIVE_API_KEY or using DefaultAzureCredential in the user's own application.

Sample apps capture microphone audio and stream it to the user's Azure resource (privacy-relevant for end users of the generated app). The two HTML-style comments in references/examples.md:27,34 are ordinary XML comments inside the Maven snippet labelling dependencies, not hidden instructions. SDK is beta; some event class names differ between SKILL.md and examples.md.
